accessibilityHint.description: Helps users understand what will happen when they perform an action

accessibilityLabel.description: VoiceOver will read this string when a user selects the element

clearable.description: Defaulted to "always" so user can clear the dates whenever there's a value.

defaultValue.description: The initial value for the input.

emptyValueLabel.description: This label is shown to the user when there's no selected date.

invalid.description: Highlights the field red and shows message below (if string) to indicate an error

maxDate.description: Maximum date the user can set.

minDate.description: Minimum date the user can set

name.description:
Adding a `name` would make this component "Form controlled" and must be
nested within a `<Form />` component.

Cannot be declared if `value` prop is used.

onChange.description: The callback that fires whenever a date gets selected.

placeholder.description: Hint text that goes above the value once the field is filled out

showMiniLabel.description:
Controls the visibility of the mini label that appears inside the input
when a value is entered. By default, the placeholder text moves up to
become a mini label. Set to false to disable this behavior.

validations.description:
Shows an error message below the field and highlights it red when the
value is invalid. Only applies when nested within a `<Form />` component.

You can see **most** of the rules you can pass in
[React-hook-form Documentation](https://react-hook-form.com/api/useform/register#options).

value.description:
The value shown on the field. This gets automatically formatted to the
account's date format.

Cannot be declared if `name` prop is used.
